title: Settings
account_delete_confirm_body: This will permanently delete your account and all your data. This cannot be undone.
sign_out_confirm_body: You can sign back in at any time.
data_delete_confirm_body: Your data deletion request will be processed within 30 days. You will be signed out immediately.
password_reset_sent: Password reset instructions have been sent to your email.
google_gemini_disclosure: AI features powered by Google Gemini
privacy_collect_body_1: Your account email and name from Clerk. Your pay gap intake answers, the AI-generated analysis, and the benchmark result. Your wins ledger entries: descriptions, impact statements, dates, values, and tags.
privacy_collect_body_2: We do not sell your data. We do not share it with advertisers. We do not use it to train AI models without your explicit consent.
privacy_use_body_1: Your pay gap data and wins are sent to Google Gemini to generate analysis and polish your win descriptions. Gemini processes your data per Google's data processing terms and does not use your data to improve Gemini unless you opt in through Google's own settings.
privacy_use_body_2: Aggregate, anonymized statistics (total users, average gap percentage) are computed from all user data to measure platform impact. No individual can be identified from these statistics.
privacy_controls_body_1: You can delete any individual win at any time from the Wins Ledger. You can re-run your pay gap analysis to update your data. You can request full deletion of all your RaiseHER data using the button below.
privacy_controls_body_2: Data deletion requests are processed within 30 days. After submission you will be signed out immediately. This action cannot be undone.
